props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: items
props.description:
Avatars to render, in order. Each entry accepts the `Avatar` props (`src`, `alt`, `text`,
`icon`, `badge`, `badgePosition`, `onStatusChange`) except `size`; every avatar uses the
group `size`. An empty array renders nothing.
examples:
import { AvatarGroup } from 'moraine'

<AvatarGroup
  items={[
    { src: '/alex.png', alt: 'Alex Rivera' },
    { text: 'BK', alt: 'Blake Kim', badge: 'icon-success' },
  ]}
/>

props.name: maxVisible
props.description:
Maximum number of avatars shown. The remaining ones are replaced by a single `+N` count
element. Fractions are rounded down and negative values show none. All items are shown when
`undefined`.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

item.description: One avatar entry: the `Avatar` props except `size`, which the group sets.

props.name: alt
props.description:
Alt text of the image and accessible name of the fallback. When `text` is not set, the fallback
shows up to two initials taken from the first letters of the first words of `alt`.

props.name: badge
props.description:
Name of an icon rendered in a small badge anchored to a corner of the avatar (see
`badgePosition`). Nothing is rendered when omitted.

props.name: badgePosition
props.description: Position of the badge relative to the avatar.

props.name: icon
props.description: Name of an icon shown in the fallback in place of `text` or initials while the image is unavailable.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description:
Called whenever the image status changes, including once after mount with the initial status
(`loading` when `src` is set, otherwise `error`). The status is `loaded` once the image has
loaded and `error` when it fails or `src` is empty. It is not called on the server.
examples:
import { Avatar } from 'moraine'

<Avatar
  src="/alex.png"
  alt="Alex Rivera"
  onStatusChange={(status) => console.log(status)}
/>

props.name: src
props.description:
URL of the avatar image. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed. When empty or missing the status is
`error` and the fallback is shown; changing it restarts loading.

props.name: text
props.description:
Text shown in the fallback while the image is loading, failed, or missing, typically initials.
It is trimmed, and when blank the initials of `alt` are used instead. Ignored when `icon` is set.
